verification_method: Independent direct OpenCascade BRepAlgoAPI_Common on the exported -fix1 STEP solids at the actual submitted assembly.json translations (all rotations zero). All 12 base seats, socket play, all neighbouring pairs, vertical withdrawal of every bin, the submitted stacked pose plus the stacking bin on all 20 host cells it fits (submitted convention and gravity rest pose), the one-shot generic stacking matrix, label glyph geometry and em, the vertical front-face label, finger probes, long-screw gauges, free-volume capacity and corner wall sections. Label sightlines are trimesh ray casts on the exported STLs (sightlines.py); overhang census in printability.py. The design generator and the submission verify.py were never executed.

font_review.embedded_ttf_description: Two-bead FDM font: every stroke is exactly two extrusion widths (w). Fusion text Height = 14 x line width (cap height); em = 20 x line width.
font_review.font_metrics: unitsPerEm 1000, OS/2 capHeight 700; caps and digits span 0-700 units, so em = measured line height / 0.7.

capacity_estimate.method: Direct OCP free volume inside each compartment rectangle from the 6.0 mm floor to the label-shelf top (nom_h - 2.2 mm); scoop, shelf and gusset solid subtracted. Solid nominal ISO hardware, 60% packing assumed, same convention as the one-shot review. Geometry only, no loading test.

corner_wall_method: Horizontal section of the exported STEP at each z; minimum distance between the outer wire and any inner wire of each section face (OCP distance). Measures the thinnest wall at that height, normally the rounded outer corner against a square inner corner.

label_sightlines.method: trimesh ray casts from up to 60 sampled raised-text top facets per top label (120 glyph-face samples for the vertical front label) toward -Y at the listed elevations and yaw; a label counts as readable at an elevation when >= 95% of its rays clear all parts. 0 and 90 degrees are edge-on for vertical and horizontal text respectively, so ray clearance there does not mean the text is legible.

labels.label: M4 / NUT WSH
labels.kind: front face, vertical (flush glyph faces in 0.6 mm recess)

printability_mesh.method: Mesh printability census for the -fix1 exports, with the one-shot exports for comparison.  Print pose is the exported orientation (README: bins and baseplate print flat, no supports). Per part: binary STL watertightness, connected bodies, and downward-facing area grouped by overhang angle (angle of the facet normal below horizontal: 0 = vertical wall, 90 = flat ceiling). Facets within 0.05 mm of the part's lowest z are bed contact and excluded. Ceiling facets (> 80 degrees) are reported with their z and largest horizontal span so bridges can be judged.

limitations: Rigid exported-geometry checks; no print, slice, printer tolerance, elephant foot, friction or filled-bin handling.
Withdrawal, stacking rest pose and sightlines are discrete samples, not continuous motion or visibility proofs; the rest pose is a pure vertical drop with no tilt.
Capacity is free volume times an assumed 60% packing fraction; no hardware was loaded and tiny-part pickup was not tried.
Probe positions use the submission parameters; label em is measured from the exported glyph heights.
Bench viewing positions are modelled as parallel rays toward -Y with +/-30 degree yaw; eye height and distance are not modelled.
